glosses: kidnapping (the crime of taking a person against their will, sometimes for ransom)

examples.text: Tom é procurado pelo FBI por sequestro.
examples.en: Tom is wanted by the FBI for kidnapping.

examples.text: O Tom foi acusado de sequestro.
examples.en: Tom has been accused of kidnapping.

examples.text: Eu acho difícil acreditar que Tom esteve envolvido no sequestro.
examples.en: I find it hard to believe that Tom was involved in the kidnapping.
